history.title: The shrine’s Sky Lens arrives
history.description: A caravan crosses the completed route, retrieves the lens from its old shrine and delivers it to town.

history.title: Dwarves prepare the mountain
history.description: Miners reinforce diversion channels and excavate a safe lava basin.

history.title: The mountain is stirring
history.description: Smoke thickens and the ground trembles. The eruption comes after choice eight; dwarven channels can protect the pass.

history.title: The island treasure returns
history.description: The crew sails to the island, lifts its waiting chest aboard and brings the gold home.

history.title: Something saw the gold
history.description: A dragon turns toward the harbor. It will arrive after your next choice; a Wizard can calm it.

history.title: A dragon makes itself at home
history.description: The Wizard calms the dragon. It carries the hoard to the tower and settles beside it.

history.title: Sky Lens installed
history.description: The Wizard fits the Sky Lens into its waiting socket.

history.title: Gold rune rings installed
history.description: The friendly dragon shares gold for the tower’s rune circuit.

history.title: Lava follows the dwarf channels
history.description: The mountain erupts into the reinforced channels, leaving the wagon pass open.

history.title: The Ember Core emerges
history.description: A dwarf cart retrieves the glowing core from the safe collection basin.

history.title: Ember Core installed
history.description: The Wizard fits the Ember Core into its waiting socket.

history.title: The summit beacon awakens
history.description: The Ember Core sends power through the gold rings and Sky Lens; the dragon curls beside the shining tower.
